title: From Subvarieties to Classes
mathematical_role: Distinguish codimension-p algebraic cycles with rational coefficients, their cycle classes, the rational Hodge-class target, possible information loss, and the conjectural converse.
learning_objective: See geometry cast a cohomological shadow: the established algebraic-to-Hodge direction, possible information loss, and the open rational-surjectivity converse.
literal_semantics: The principal map is labelled cl^p.
The target names H^{2p}(X,Q) intersect H^{p,p}(X).
The established direction is visually separated from the open converse.
nonliteral_semantics: The rendered toroidal variety and highlighted cycle ribbons are generic geometric teaching tokens, not a specific projective variety or subvarieties.
The layered target chamber illustrates possible compression/information loss without asserting a particular kernel.
Shape, color, overlap, and multiplicity encode no algebraic dimensions or Hodge numbers.
The diagram asserts neither injectivity nor general surjectivity.

notes: Representation-repair realization follows independent rejection of the SVG-only candidate.

renderer.version_or_environment: requirements/visual-pedagogy-render.txt; deterministic Matplotlib/Numpy hybrid raster renderer v4
reproducibility_notes: No randomness or external service is used.

derivatives.role: current 3D hybrid review candidate; not live documentary asset

accessibility.alt_text: A rendered geometric variety with highlighted cycle ribbons maps by cl superscript p into a layered cohomology chamber for rational Hodge classes; established direction and open converse are separated below.
accessibility.long_description: The hero geometry is a synthetic 3D variety-like surface carrying highlighted cycle ribbons. An arrow labelled cl^p leads to a layered target chamber labelled H^{2p}(X,Q) intersect H^{p,p}(X). A lower panel distinguishes the established cycle-class direction from the open converse.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Pedagogical exposition of the established cycle-class direction and location of the conjectural rational-surjectivity converse.
not_claimed: A proof of the Hodge conjecture

supersession_reason: Representation-layer repair gives the geometry-to-cohomology map a richer 3D/hybrid teaching realization while preserving coefficient and converse distinctions.
